reader_boundary_zh: 支持长期防晒作为皮肤健康基础；不支持把防晒写成逆龄治疗。

scope: Skin and appearance aging public draft topic; not a longevity endpoint.

reader_boundary_zh: 处方维A酸、孕期、敏感肌和皮肤病人群需要医生评估；不提供浓度和用法建议。

title_zh: 口服胶原肽与皮肤弹性/水分
scope: Skin and appearance aging public draft topic; not a longevity endpoint.
